senses.en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.

ex.en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
ex.zh: 你先烧水，我来找杯子。

ex.en: Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
ex.zh: 每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。

tip: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。

senses.en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.

ex.en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。

ex.en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
ex.zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。

col: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品
a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品
a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

senses.en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions.
Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential.
Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.

ex.en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
ex.zh: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。

ex.en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
ex.zh: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。

col: afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

senses.en: the bars you hold to steer a bike

ex.en: Hold the handlebars firmly when you ride.
ex.zh: 骑车时握紧车把。

ex.en: The handlebars of the bicycle are too high for me.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车的车把对我来说太高了。

tip: handlebars 常用复数，指自行车/摩托车的车把。
scene: A close view of bicycle handlebars with a rider's hands on them.

senses.en: to give something to each person

ex.en: The volunteers handed out water to the runners.
ex.zh: 志愿者给跑步者分发水。

ex.en: She handed out the invitations at school.
ex.zh: 她在学校分发请柬。

tip: hand out 是“分发”；handout 是名词“讲义”。
scene: Volunteers handing out bottles of water to runners.

senses.en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.

ex.en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
ex.zh: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。

ex.en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
ex.zh: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。

col: be unable to attend｜无法出席
be unable to afford｜负担不起
be unable to cope｜无法应付
tip: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

senses.en: so that; for the purpose of

ex.en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
ex.zh: 她努力学习以便通过考试。

ex.en: In order to save money, we cook at home.
ex.zh: 为了省钱，我们在家做饭。

tip: in order to + 动词原形 表示目的“为了”。
scene: A student studying at night with a goal list on the desk.

senses.en: to include something as a necessary part
to make someone take part in an activity

ex.en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
ex.zh: 我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。

ex.en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。

col: involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事
tip: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
ex.zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。

tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

senses.en: into two equal parts

ex.en: Cut the apple in half and share it.
ex.zh: 把苹果切成两半分着吃。

ex.en: She folded the paper in half.
ex.zh: 她把纸对折。

tip: cut/divide in half 表示“分成两半”。
scene: A knife cutting an apple in half on a cutting board.

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex.en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
ex.zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。

ex.en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。

tip: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft

ex.en: The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
ex.zh: 航班取消后，航空公司给我们发了新机票。

ex.en: Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.
ex.zh: 航空公司可以通过投资更高效的飞机并减少不必要的航班来降低环境影响。

tip: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。

senses.en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves
to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development

ex.en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
ex.zh: 姐姐对我有很大的影响。

ex.en: Advertising can influence children's food preferences, which makes responsible marketing particularly important for public health.
ex.zh: 广告会影响儿童的食物偏好，因此负责任的营销对公众健康尤为重要。

col: have an influence on｜对……有影响
tip: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

senses.en: A substance used to make things, including cloth.
Information or ideas used for study or creative work.
Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.

ex.en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
ex.zh: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。

ex.en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
ex.zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。

tip: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。

senses.en: a machine that records phone messages

ex.en: She left a message on my answerphone.
ex.zh: 她在我的答录机上留了言。

ex.en: The answerphone recorded three calls while we were out.
ex.zh: 我们外出时答录机录了三个电话。

tip: answerphone 是英式说法，指电话答录机。
scene: An old answerphone machine on a desk with a blinking light.

senses.en: an idea offered for someone to consider
a slight sign that something exists or may be true

ex.en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
ex.zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。

ex.en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
ex.zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。

tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

senses.en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays
Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area

ex.en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。

ex.en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
ex.zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。

tip: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

senses.en: the flat green part of a plant

ex.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天叶子变黄。

ex.en: A leaf fell from the tree and landed on the path.
ex.zh: 一片叶子从树上落下，落在小路上。

tip: leaf 的复数是 leaves（不规则变化）。
scene: A green leaf with veins falling from a tree in autumn.

senses.en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move.
Leaving very little extra time, money, or space.
Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.

ex.en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
ex.zh: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。

ex.en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
ex.zh: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。

col: a tight deadline｜很紧的截止期限
tip: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

senses.en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films

ex.en: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
ex.zh: 那位女演员向剧院外的人群挥手。

ex.en: A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
ex.zh: 一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。

tip: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

senses.en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen.
Put things in a particular order or position.

ex.en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
ex.zh: 我约好和表亲在电影院外见面。

ex.en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
ex.zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。

col: arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事
tip: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

senses.en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats

ex.en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
ex.zh: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。

ex.en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
ex.zh: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。

col: a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

senses.zh: 穿着得体的；衣着考究的
senses.en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.

ex.en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
ex.zh: 一位衣着考究的客人穿着熨烫平整的西装到来。

ex.en: Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.
ex.zh: 尽管衣着得体的求职者可能留下良好的第一印象，雇主仍应优先考虑相关技能和工作经验。

col: a well-dressed applicant｜衣着得体的求职者
tip: 强调穿着整洁得体，不一定指衣服昂贵或紧跟潮流。

senses.en: Kept out of sight or not easily noticed.

ex.en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房门后发现了一个隐蔽的橱柜。

ex.en: Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.
ex.zh: 消费者应考虑网购的隐性成本，包括运费和退货费用。

tip: 也是hide的过去分词；隐藏不等于肉眼不可见。

senses.en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation
all members of a group, or the total member count

ex.en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
ex.zh: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。

ex.en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
ex.zh: 价格合理的会员费可以鼓励更多居民使用当地体育设施，改善健康状况。

col: renew your membership｜续办会员资格
tip: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

senses.en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container
examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts

ex.en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
ex.zh: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。

ex.en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
ex.zh: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。

col: unpack a suitcase｜取出行李箱中的物品
unpack boxes｜打开箱子取出物品
tip: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

senses.en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced
A company that makes films
A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room

ex.en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
ex.zh: 那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。

ex.en: Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.
ex.zh: 为价格可负担的工作室提供公共资金，能帮助新兴艺术家丰富城市文化生活。

tip: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

senses.en: To make someone feel afraid.

ex.en: Sudden loud noises can frighten our new puppy.
ex.zh: 突然的巨响会吓到我们新养的小狗。

ex.en: Alarming news reports may frighten children, so adults should explain difficult events in an appropriate way.
ex.zh: 令人不安的新闻报道可能吓到儿童，因此成人应以恰当的方式解释复杂事件。

col: frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做
frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

senses.en: between young and old, about 40 to 60

ex.en: The middle-aged man walked his dog every day.
ex.zh: 这位中年男子每天遛狗。

ex.en: The book is popular with middle-aged readers.
ex.zh: 这本书受中年读者欢迎。

tip: middle-aged 指中年（约40-60岁）。
scene: A middle-aged man walking his dog in a park.

senses.en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle.
The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.

ex.en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
ex.zh: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。

ex.en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
ex.zh: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。

tip: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

senses.en: to act in a particular way
to act politely and do what is expected
to work or react in a particular way

ex.en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
ex.zh: 有客人来家里时，我们的狗表现得很平静。

ex.en: Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.
ex.zh: 孩子往往通过观察身边的成年人，学习在社交场合如何举止得当。

tip: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

senses.en: a person or organisation that purchases something
someone whose job is choosing goods for a business

ex.en: The buyer checked the bicycle before handing over cash.
ex.zh: 买家在付现金前检查了那辆自行车。

ex.en: First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.
ex.zh: 由于房价上涨速度超过工资，首次购房者往往难以进入住房市场。

tip: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

senses.en: A desire to upset or hurt someone deliberately.
To deliberately upset someone, often because you feel angry.

ex.en: He hid his sister's favourite toy out of spite.
ex.zh: 他出于恶意，把妹妹最喜欢的玩具藏了起来。

ex.en: In spite of limited funding, the community centre continues to provide valuable support for local families.
ex.zh: 尽管资金有限，社区中心仍继续为当地家庭提供宝贵的支持。

tip: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

senses.en: a person who tests or judges exams

ex.en: The examiner asked me three questions.
ex.zh: 考官问了我三个问题。

ex.en: She was nervous when the examiner walked in.
ex.zh: 考官进来时她很紧张。

tip: examiner 是考官，在考试中出题/评分的人。
scene: An examiner sitting at a desk with papers in an exam room.

senses.en: to make something new or bring something into existence
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
ex.zh: 我们用折纸做出了一只色彩鲜艳的小鸟。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

col: create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: buses and trains that everyone can use

ex.en: Public transport is cheap and convenient here.
ex.zh: 这里公共交通便宜又方便。

ex.en: Many people use public transport to go to work.
ex.zh: 许多人乘公共交通上班。

tip: public transport 是公共交通（公交、地铁、火车）。
scene: A bus and a train moving through a city street.

senses.en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose.
The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.

ex.en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
ex.zh: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。

ex.en: Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.
ex.zh: 有效组织医疗服务能够缩短等候时间，并改善农村社区获得医疗服务的机会。

col: require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

senses.en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is.
To discover or establish something through examination.
To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.

ex.en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
ex.zh: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？

ex.en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。

tip: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

senses.en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.

ex.en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
ex.zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。

ex.en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
ex.zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。

tip: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

senses.en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。

ex.en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
ex.zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。

tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

senses.en: How much of something there is.
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
ex.zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。

ex.en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

senses.en: the title of a news report

senses.zh: 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
senses.en: to be the main news story or featured performer

ex.en: The headline caught my attention while I ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我吃早餐时，那个新闻标题吸引了我的注意。

ex.en: Misleading headlines can shape public opinion before readers examine the evidence presented in a news report.
ex.zh: 误导性的标题可能在读者查看新闻报道中的证据之前就影响公众舆论。

tip: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

senses.en: to think carefully about something before deciding
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们正在考虑明天坐火车，而不开车。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money.
Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement.
A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.

ex.en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
ex.zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。

ex.en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
ex.zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。

col: give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳
tip: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

senses.en: a person who dives under water or jumps into water

ex.en: The diver explored the coral reef.
ex.zh: 潜水员探索了珊瑚礁。

ex.en: The diver jumped into the pool perfectly.
ex.zh: 跳水者完美地跳入泳池。

tip: diver 指潜水员或跳水运动员；diving 是潜水/跳水运动。
scene: A diver in scuba gear swimming near a colourful coral reef.

senses.en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years.
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
ex.zh: 这些植物在温暖干燥的气候中长得很好。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.zh: 身体不舒服的；不舒适的
senses.en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort.
Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.

ex.en: These new shoes feel uncomfortable after a long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很久以后，这双新鞋穿着很不舒服。

ex.en: Students may feel uncomfortable asking questions in large classes, which can limit their participation and understanding.
ex.zh: 学生在大班课堂上提问时可能感到不自在，这会影响他们的参与和理解。

col: an uncomfortable chair｜不舒服的椅子
an uncomfortable silence｜令人尴尬的沉默
tip: 既可指身体不适，也可指心理上的不自在。

senses.en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。

ex.en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
ex.zh: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。

tip: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

senses.en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part.
Located in the southeast, or coming from that direction.
Towards or in the southeast.

ex.en: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
ex.zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝东南，早晨能照到阳光。

ex.en: Population growth in the southeast has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 东南部的人口增长增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。

tip: 名词前常用the；副词不用：head southeast。

senses.en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.

ex.en: She grows fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种了新鲜香草。

ex.en: Growing herbs at home can encourage healthier cooking and reduce the need for packaged seasonings.
ex.zh: 在家种植香草可以鼓励更健康的烹饪方式，并减少对包装调味料的需求。

tip: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

senses.en: a short video

ex.en: She shared a funny video clip with her friends.
ex.zh: 她给朋友分享了一个搞笑短视频。

ex.en: The video clip of the concert went popular online.
ex.zh: 音乐会的视频片段在网上火了。

tip: video clip 是短视频/片段。
scene: A phone screen playing a short video clip with a play button.

senses.en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.
To come off a surface in thin pieces.
The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
ex.zh: 我切胡萝卜时，你能帮忙削这些土豆吗？

ex.en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 家庭可以将蔬菜皮制成堆肥而非丢弃，从而减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。

tip: peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。

senses.en: Stories about imagined people and events.
Something invented that is presented as true.

ex.en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。

ex.en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
ex.zh: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。

col: a work of fiction｜一部小说作品
tip: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

senses.en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.

ex.en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
ex.zh: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。

ex.en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
ex.zh: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。

tip: 常修饰分词或形容词，如fully prepared。

senses.en: having the training, skills, or experience needed for something
not complete or unconditional; involving limits or reservations

ex.en: Only a qualified electrician should repair that damaged socket.
ex.zh: 只有具备资质的电工才应该修理那个损坏的插座。

ex.en: Governments should invest in teacher training to ensure that every school has enough qualified staff.
ex.zh: 政府应投入资金培训教师，确保每所学校都有足够的合格教职人员。

col: qualified for the job｜能胜任这份工作
tip: qualified for＋名词；qualified to do表示有资格做。

senses.en: A particular place or position.
A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings.
Notice or recognise someone or something.

ex.en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。

ex.en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
ex.zh: 卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。

tip: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

senses.en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My niece brought her new puppy to our picnic.
ex.zh: 我的侄女带着她新养的小狗来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help adults care for relatives, including a young niece or nephew.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助成年人照顾亲属，包括年幼的侄女或侄子。

col: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女
nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

senses.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.
Used with to to express what is likely or expected.

ex.en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

col: ought not to do｜不应该做
ought to have done｜本应该做
tip: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

senses.en: A doctor's written order for medicine, or the medicine ordered
A suggested method for dealing with a problem
Available only with a doctor's written order

ex.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for eye drops.
ex.zh: 医生给我开了眼药水的处方。

ex.en: Requiring a prescription for certain medicines can reduce misuse and protect public health.
ex.zh: 要求某些药物凭处方购买，可以减少滥用并保护公众健康。

col: a prescription for success｜成功之道
tip: 处方用for引出药物；on prescription指凭处方。

senses.en: short for goalkeeper, or a person who looks after things

ex.en: The keeper caught the ball easily.
ex.zh: 守门员轻松接住了球。

ex.en: The zoo keeper feeds the animals every day.
ex.zh: 动物园管理员每天喂动物。

tip: keeper 常指守门员（goalkeeper 的简称），也指管理员。
scene: A goalkeeper catching a ball in front of the goal.

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

ex.en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。

ex.en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。

tip: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

senses.en: early enough; before the deadline

ex.en: We arrived in time for the film.
ex.zh: 我们及时赶到了，赶上了电影。

ex.en: Finish your homework in time for dinner.
ex.zh: 及时完成作业好赶上晚饭。

tip: in time 是“及时，来得及”；on time 是“准时”。
scene: People rushing into a cinema just before the film starts.

senses.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface
a flat, thin, round object

ex.en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。

ex.en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
ex.zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。

tip: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

senses.en: to announce something publicly or officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The judges declared her the winner of the competition.
ex.zh: 评委宣布她赢得了比赛。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.

ex.en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
ex.zh: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。

tip: 复数可写mosquitoes或mosquitos。

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

ex.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
ex.zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。

ex.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
ex.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

col: have an edge over｜比……有优势
tip: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

senses.en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone.
Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.

ex.en: She gave us a cheerful greeting at the door.
ex.zh: 她在门口愉快地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Learning local greeting customs can help international students build relationships and avoid misunderstandings in their new environment.
ex.zh: 了解当地的问候习俗可以帮助国际学生建立人际关系，避免在新环境中产生误解。

tip: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

senses.en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use

ex.en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
ex.zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere
using a particular method, system, or person

ex.en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
ex.zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。

ex.en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
ex.zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。

tip: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

senses.en: The process or result of becoming better.
A change that makes something better.

ex.en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
ex.zh: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。

col: an improvement on｜比…更好的事物
tip: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。

senses.en: having skill from doing something for a long time

ex.en: She is an experienced driver.
ex.zh: 她是一位有经验的司机。

ex.en: The experienced teacher helped the new students.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的老师帮助了新学生。

tip: experienced 是形容词“有经验的”；反义 inexperienced。
scene: An experienced pilot in uniform speaking to young trainees.

senses.en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train
a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier
to complain angrily and strongly about something

ex.en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。

ex.en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
ex.zh: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。

col: hold onto the rail｜抓住扶手
tip: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。

senses.en: to move down, or to bring something down

ex.en: Get down from that tree carefully!
ex.zh: 小心地从树上下来！

ex.en: She got the books down from the high shelf.
ex.zh: 她把书从高架子上取下来。

tip: get down 表示“下来”或“取下”。
scene: A child climbing carefully down from a tree.

senses.en: A spoken or written account giving information about something
To give information about an event or situation
To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
ex.zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。

ex.en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

tip: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

senses.en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

ex.en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
ex.zh: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: To deal with a situation, task, or person.
To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands.
The part of an object used for holding or moving it.

ex.en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
ex.zh: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？

ex.en: Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.
ex.zh: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。

tip: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

senses.en: to look after children while their parents are out

ex.en: She babysits for the neighbours on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 她每周五晚上帮邻居照看孩子。

ex.en: I babysit my little cousin when my aunt works.
ex.zh: 姑姑上班时我照看小表弟。

tip: babysit 是动词“照看小孩”；照看者叫 babysitter。
scene: A teenager reading a picture book to a small child on a sofa.

senses.en: to give something and receive something else in return
an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas
a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded

ex.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
ex.zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？

ex.en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。

tip: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

ex.en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
ex.zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。

ex.en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
ex.zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。

tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

senses.en: to reduce sound, or to refuse

ex.en: Please turn down the music; it's too loud.
ex.zh: 请把音乐调小，太吵了。

ex.en: She turned down the job offer.
ex.zh: 她拒绝了这份工作邀请。

tip: turn down 表示“调低”或“拒绝”。
scene: A person turning down the volume on a stereo.

senses.en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.

ex.en: My sociable neighbour invites everyone over for tea.
ex.zh: 我那位爱交际的邻居邀请大家去喝茶。

ex.en: Shared spaces can encourage residents to become more sociable and develop stronger relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 公共空间可以鼓励居民更多地与人交往，并与邻居建立更紧密的关系。

col: a sociable atmosphere｜友好的社交氛围
tip: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

senses.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.
To give something to someone for their efforts or help.

ex.en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
ex.zh: 我们给了小狗一块零食作为奖励。

ex.en: Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.
ex.zh: 学校应奖励持续的努力，而不是只关注成绩最好的学生。

col: reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人
tip: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

senses.en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft
A group working together on a particular practical task
Work as a member of a boat's crew

ex.en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
ex.zh: 机组人员面带亲切的笑容，欢迎我们登机。

ex.en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
ex.zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。

tip: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

senses.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
ex.zh: 鸭妈妈张开翅膀保护小鸭。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

ex.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。

ex.en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

senses.en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son.
A male ruler of a small independent state.

ex.en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
ex.zh: 王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。

tip: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

senses.en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
ex.zh: 舞者表演结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.

ex.en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
ex.zh: 在手边备好手电筒，以防出现紧急情况。

ex.en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
ex.zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

senses.en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort.
To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring.
A force or influence that slows movement or progress.

ex.en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
ex.zh: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。

ex.en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。

col: a drag on growth｜增长的拖累
tip: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。

senses.en: To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我得复习，准备生物考试。

ex.en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
ex.zh: 政府应修订过时的住房政策，确保年轻家庭仍能获得负担得起的住房。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.

ex.en: My sister wore a blue gown at her graduation.
ex.zh: 姐姐在毕业典礼上穿了一件蓝色学位袍。

ex.en: Universities should provide career guidance before graduation to help students make a successful transition into employment.
ex.zh: 大学应在学生毕业前提供职业指导，帮助他们顺利过渡到职场。

tip: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

senses.en: to answer someone or respond to a message
an answer given in speech or writing

ex.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
ex.zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。

ex.en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
ex.zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。

col: reply to a message｜回复消息
in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: Something bought for less than its usual price
To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement
An agreement about what each person will do

ex.en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的冬季外套买得真划算。

ex.en: Consumers can often bargain with local sellers, although fixed prices are more common in large stores.
ex.zh: 消费者通常可以与当地商贩讨价还价，但大型商店更常采用固定价格。

col: a real bargain｜真正的便宜货
bargain with someone｜与某人讨价还价
keep your side of the bargain｜履行自己约定的义务
tip: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

senses.en: a flat pan used for frying food

ex.en: Heat the frying pan before adding the oil.
ex.zh: 先加热煎锅再放油。

ex.en: She put the frying pan on the stove.
ex.zh: 她把煎锅放到炉子上。

tip: frying pan 是平底煎锅；美式常说 skillet。
scene: A frying pan on a stove with oil sizzling.

senses.en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation
something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到来时，孩子们兴奋得跳了起来。

ex.en: Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.
ex.zh: 虽然国际体育赛事令人振奋，但主办城市必须仔细评估其长期财务成本。

col: contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

senses.en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet.
Bring something into use or a place for the first time.
Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.

ex.en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
ex.zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。

ex.en: Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.
ex.zh: 学校应引入实用的理财教育，帮助学生成年后负责任地管理财务。

col: introduce someone to someone｜把某人介绍给某人
introduce someone to a subject｜引导某人了解一门学科
tip: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

senses.en: Experiencing bad things because of chance
Believed to bring bad luck

ex.en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
ex.zh: 我们真倒霉，只差几秒就错过了公交车。

ex.en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
ex.zh: 不幸在考试期间生病的学生应获得其他考核安排。

tip: unlucky强调运气差，不等于unhappy（不开心）。

senses.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly
An act of violence or strong criticism
A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms

ex.en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
ex.zh: 我走近池塘时，那只鹅突然啄起我的包。

ex.en: Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.
ex.zh: 批评者猛烈抨击这项提案，因为它几乎没有为贫困家庭提供支持。

col: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击
attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex.zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

ex.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
ex.zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward.
Further advanced than others or earlier than expected.
In the future, or in preparation for it.

ex.en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
ex.zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。

ex.en: Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
ex.zh: 城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。

col: ahead of schedule｜比预定时间提前
ahead of the competition｜领先竞争对手
tip: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。
